attributes.text: A macro is a list of actions that runs when you tap a tag.
attributes.originalText: A macro is a list of actions that runs when you tap a tag.

attributes.text: Tap New macro and pick a template, or start blank.
attributes.originalText: Tap New macro and pick a template, or start blank.

attributes.text: Fill in anything marked "Needs setup", then Save.
attributes.originalText: Fill in anything marked "Needs setup", then Save.

attributes.text: Tap "Write trigger to a tag" and hold a sticker to the back of the phone.
attributes.originalText: Tap "Write trigger to a tag" and hold a sticker to the back of the phone.

attributes.text: Close TagMacro, lift the sticker away, and tap it to run the macro.
attributes.originalText: Close TagMacro, lift the sticker away, and tap it to run the macro.
